newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt frees last group of alleged Satan worshippers.
newsitem.headline: Egypt frees last group of alleged Satan worshippers.

text.p: Egypt has set free four youths detained for allegedly joining a devil-worshipping cult, the last of the group to be freed, security sources said on Monday.
"The state security prosecution decided to set them free on bail, without being charged," one of the sources said. "The case is thus considered closed."
Egyptian police in January detained almost 100 people who according to the interior ministry belonged to a devil-worshipping cult that aimed at spreading illicit practices and behaviour in Egypt.
Since then, the prosecution has set free groups of them.
